jobs.title: Senior Product Manager
Senior IT Project Manager (m/w/d)
jobs.description:
Die dokSAFE GmbH ist ein Leipziger Softwareunternehmen, das sich auf die Entwicklung der SaaS-Lösung ACTAPORT spezialisiert hat. Wir arbeiten gemeinsam daran, mit unserer Kanzleisoftware die Arbeitswelt in der Anwaltskanzlei zu revolutionieren.

Du liebst es, komplexe Projekte von der Konzeption bis zum Go-live zu steuern — und dabei sowohl Entwickler:innen als auch C-Level-Entscheider:innen auf Kurs zu halten? Dann suchen wir genau DICH! Als Senior IT Project Manager (m/w/d) übernimmst Du die End-to-End-Verantwortung für unsere strategischen Produkt- und Kundenprojekte. Du bist die Schnittstelle zwischen Business, Entwicklung und externen Partnern — und treibst dabei sowohl operative Exzellenz als auch die Skalierung von ACTAPORT aktiv voran.

Aufgaben

  • Du leitest eigenverantwortlich komplexe Software-Implementierungsprojekte von der Konzeption bis zum Go-live und stellst dabei Qualität, Zeitplan und Budget sicher.
  • Du baust crossfunktionale Projektteams aus Entwicklung, Legal, Sales und Customer Success auf und führst diese durch alle Projektphasen.
  • Du begleitest Kanzleien und Rechtsabteilungen eng bei der Einführung unserer Lösungen — inklusive Change Management und nachhaltiger Nutzerakzeptanz.
  • Du definierst und überwachst KPIs, Meilensteine und Budgets, erkennst Risiken frühzeitig und steuerst proaktiv gegen.
  • Du identifizierst Prozessverbesserungen und Skalierungspotenziale und gestaltest unsere PM-Methodik aktiv mit.
  • Du baust langfristige Kundenbeziehungen auf und berätst Stakeholder auf C-Level mit dem Ziel nachhaltiger Partnerschaften.

Qualifikation

  • Mindestens 6 Jahre Erfahrung im Projektmanagement — idealerweise in einem SaaS-, Legal-Tech- oder B2B-Tech-Umfeld — und nachweisliche Erfolge bei der Leitung großer, komplexer Projekte mit multiplen Stakeholdern zeigen, dass Du Projekte sicher ins Ziel bringst.

  • Wir wünschen uns darüber hinaus:

  • nachweisliche Erfolge bei der Leitung großer, vielschichtiger Projekte mit Budget- und Teamverantwortung

  • ausgeprägte Kommunikationsstärke — Du überzeugst sowohl Entwickler:innen als auch Entscheider:innen auf C-Level

  • strukturierte, lösungsorientierte Arbeitsweise und hohe Eigenverantwortung

  • Von Vorteil sind eine Zertifizierung nach PMP, PRINCE2 oder IPMA, Erfahrung mit agilen Methoden (Scrum, Kanban) in hybriden Projekten sowie Grundkenntnisse im deutschen oder europäischen Vertragsrecht oder Erfahrung in der Zusammenarbeit mit juristischen Fachkräften.

  • Deine sehr guten Deutsch- und Englischkenntnisse ermöglichen eine reibungslose Kommunikation im Team und mit internationalen Kund:innen.

Benefits

  • Wir bieten eine sehr gute Work-Life-Balance durch flexible Arbeitszeiten.
  • Wir leben ein hybrides Arbeitsmodell — Homeoffice ist bei uns selbstverständlich möglich.
  • Neben 30 Urlaubstagen erhältst Du eine wettbewerbsfähige Vergütung sowie zusätzliche finanzielle Benefits (Kitazuschuss, steuerfreier Sachbezug als Deutschlandticket oder 50 €-Gutschein).
  • Dich erwarten flache Hierarchien und kurze Entscheidungswege.
  • Dich begrüßen erfahrene Teamplayer:innen in einem motivierten, inklusiven Team. Nach Deiner ausführlichen Einarbeitung arbeitest Du eigenverantwortlich in diesem.
  • Dich erwarten vielfältige Möglichkeiten für Deine persönliche und fachliche Entwicklung sowie eine optionale betriebliche Altersvorsorge.

Werde Teil unseres agilen Teams und revolutioniere mit uns die Arbeitswelt in Anwaltskanzleien. Gestalte Deine Zukunft bei dokSAFE GmbH und bewirb Dich jetzt - wir freuen uns auf Dich!

jobs.title: Growth Product Manager
jobs.description:
About ScholarshipOwl

ScholarshipOwl is the largest scholarship marketplace in the U.S., connecting over 14 million Gen Z students with private scholarships — and the brands that power them. Our mission is to make education financing more accessible and engaging, while giving brands a way to connect with the next generation.

We’re powered by AI technology that simplifies scholarship discovery, streamlines the application process, and delivers measurable results for both students and partners. Whether it’s helping students secure funding or enabling brands to run impactful campaigns, we’re reshaping how education is funded — and discovered.

The Role

We’re looking for a Growth Product Manager to take full ownership of the conversion engine at ScholarshipOwl, from the first visitor touchpoint through to a paid subscription. This is a high-impact, high-velocity role for someone who lives in the data, thrives on experimentation, and values action over perfection.

You will be the architect of our growth. You’ll spend your days identifying leaks in the funnel, hypothesizing solutions, and working alongside a dedicated pod of engineers and designers to ship experiments that move the needle on revenue and retention. If you are a "full-stack" growth thinker who can move from a Mixpanel cohort analysis to a detailed technical spec this is the role for you.

What You’ll Do

  • Own the Conversion Engine: Take end-to-end responsibility for the user journey, optimizing every step from landing page registration to paywall conversion and subscription retention.

  • Drive the Experiment Roadmap: Build, prioritize, and maintain a high-tempo experimentation backlog. You will use frameworks (like ICE or RICE) to ensure we are always working on the highest-leverage growth bets.

  • Analyze & Diagnose: Monitor funnel and retention metrics daily in Mixpanel. You’ll identify exactly where users are dropping off and perform deep-dive discovery to understand the why.

  • Ship with Velocity: Write precise product specs and acceptance criteria that allow engineering and design to execute independently. We prioritize shipping "good enough" tests today to get data, rather than waiting for "perfect" features next month.

  • Optimize Revenue Levers: Design and run pricing, paywall, and offer optimization tests. You’ll also evaluate new growth levers like organic loops, landing page personalization, and winback programs.

  • Collaborate Cross-Functionally: Lead a dedicated pod of engineers and designers, maintaining strong working relationships with our dashboard and B2B teams to drive unified sprint priorities.

  • Continuous Discovery: Conduct meaningful customer discovery interviews with our Gen-Z audience to uncover behavioral insights that data alone can’t show.

What We’re Looking For

  • 4+ years of Product Management experience, specifically in a **Growth-**focused role.

  • Experimentation Mastery: Proven track record of designing, running, and analyzing A/B tests that resulted in measurable improvements to business KPIs (CVR, ARPU, Churn).

  • Data Fluency: You are a power user of product analytics tools (Mixpanel, Amplitude, or similar). You don't wait for a data analyst; you find the answers yourself.

  • SaaS/Subscription Expertise: You understand the nuances of subscription models—trial-to-paid transitions, renewal cycles, and friction-point reduction.

  • Technical Precision: Ability to write clear, "dev-ready" product specs and acceptance criteria. You understand technical trade-offs and how to scope an MVP.

  • Mentoring & Leadership: A mentoring and knowledge-sharing mindset with a desire to level up the broader team on growth methodologies and experimentation rigor.

  • Gen-Z Empathy: You have an intuition for (or experience with) B2C products targeting younger audiences and understand their unique digital behaviors.

  • Growth Mindset: You are comfortable with ambiguity, fast-moving environments, and the fact that 70% of experiments might fail—as long as we learn from them.

Bonus Points:

  • Experience with payment platforms (Stripe, Braintree) or Figma/prototyping tools.

  • Knowledge of lifecycle/email marketing, SEO, and paid acquisition channels.

  • Growth-focused certifications (e.g., Reforge).

  • Background in EdTech or student-facing products.

Why Join ScholarshipOwl?

  • Mission-Driven Work – Build technology that helps students unlock education opportunities.

  • Fully Remote – Work from anywhere while collaborating with a global team.

  • High Impact & Ownership – You aren't just a cog in a machine; you own the revenue engine.

  • Unlimited PTO – We value results over hours worked and trust you to manage your time.

  • Coworking Budget – $200/month to invest in your ideal coworking workspace.

  • Continuous Learning Culture – We support curiosity, experimentation, and growth.

  • Annual Company Off-sites – Connect with your teammates in person at various locations around the globe.

Ready to move the needle? Apply now and show us how you’d build the future of student growth.

Die campoint AG ist Technologiepartner und Betreiber einer der größten deutschsprachigen Plattformen für die Creator Economy und Digital Entertainment - von der Consumer-Plattform bis zur B2B-Infrastruktur, mit der Creators und Agenturen ihr Business aufbauen und steuern. Dabei sind Creators für uns keine User, sondern Unternehmer, deren Erfolg unmittelbar von unseren Produkten abhängt. Das bestimmt, wie wir priorisieren. Wir gestalten nach unserer Vision. Wir leben von Teamplay, Hands-on-Mentalität und einer Kommunikation auf Augenhöhe.

Aufgaben

Du bekommst echte Ownership für zugewiesene Produkt-Streams innerhalb unseres B2B-Portfolios. Das bedeutet: Du entscheidest, was gebaut wird und was nicht - auf Basis von Creator-Feedback, Umsatzdaten und strategischem Rahmen. Wir haben keine langen Abstimmungsrunden. Du bist das Quality-Gateway für Dein Team und Eure Releases.

Du navigierst eigenständig durch ein komplexes Stakeholder-Umfeld. Wir erwarten, dass Du Konflikte direkt löst - nicht eskalierst.

Die strategische Richtung gibt der Head of Product vor. Deine Aufgabe ist es, sie mit hoher Eigenständigkeit und Qualitätsanspruch umzusetzen und innerhalb Deiner Streams bessere Entscheidungen zu treffen, als wenn er sie selbst treffen würde.

Das ist kein Stepping-Stone in die Produktstrategie. Das ist eine Rolle für jemanden, der im Operativen exzellent ist und das als Stärke sieht, nicht als Einschränkung.

  • Du verantwortest Discovery, Priorisierung und Delivery in Deinen Produkt-Streams von Anfang bis Ende.
  • Du übersetzt qualitative Creator-Insights und starke Signale direkt in mutige Entscheidungen - ohne Dich in endlosen Datenanalysen ("Analysis Paralysis") zu verlieren.
  • Du schreibst klare Specs und Tickets, die ohne Nacharbeit ins Development gehen.
  • Du erkennst, wann ein Prozess oder Sprint-Ritual der schnellen Problemlösung im Weg steht, und brichst es pragmatisch in Absprache mit dem Team auf.
  • Du holst externe Impulse aktiv rein und arbeitest sie pragmatisch ein.
  • Du behältst den Überblick über technische Abhängigkeiten, ohne Dich in ihnen zu verlieren.

Qualifikation

  • Du hast 4–6 Jahre Erfahrung als PO oder PM in einem digitalen Produkt-Umfeld mit nachweisbarer Execution-Qualität, nicht nur Prozess-Compliance.
  • Du baust Dir schnell echtes Verständnis von Plattform-Logik, Creator-Mindset und wirtschaftlichen Zusammenhängen auf.

Benefits

Join us in shaping the future of hospitality!
 

About the Role

Canary is at the forefront of providing AI-powered technology solutions to the hospitality industry. Our mission is to help hotels modernize operations, enhance guest experiences, and drive business results through intuitive, digital-first products. Our innovative platform is trusted by hotels worldwide for its ability to streamline operations and improve guest satisfaction.

We are looking for a Senior Product Manager to join our growing team and help lead the development of impactful products across key areas of our platform. In this role, you’ll take ownership of complex problem spaces, work closely with cross-functional partners, and drive initiatives that are critical to Canary’s continued growth and customer success.

You’ll have the opportunity to work on a variety of high-leverage product areas, such as:

  • Guest communication
  • Digital check-in
  • Payments
  • Upsells
  • And more!

As part of a globally distributed team, you’ll collaborate regularly with colleagues and customers across time zones—so flexibility, asynchronous communication, and strong cross-cultural collaboration skills are essential.

If you are a strong product thinker with at least 5 years of product management experience, and you’re excited to help shape the future of hospitality tech, we’d love to connect.


Responsibilities
  • Define and execute product strategy, roadmap, and delivery plans for the Canary platform.
  • Partner with Engineering and Design teams to bring intuitive, scalable, and reliable features to life.
  • Collaborate with stakeholders across Sales, Customer Success, and Marketing to ensure successful product launches and strong customer adoption.
  • Conduct in-depth customer research and product analysis to inform prioritization and uncover new opportunities.
  • Translate complex customer and business needs into clear product requirements and user stories.
  • Set clear goals and success metrics, and use data to drive continuous improvement and iteration.
  • Help mentor product managers and contribute to the broader product culture and processes.

    • Qualifications
  • 5+ years of product management experience in B2B SaaS or a technology-driven environment.
  • Proven ability to define and ship successful products that deliver measurable business outcomes.
  • Strong product intuition and customer empathy—you understand how to solve real problems with elegant, user-focused solutions.
  • Experience working closely with Engineering and Design teams to drive execution in an agile environment.
  • Skilled at making data-informed decisions while remaining grounded in customer feedback.
  • Comfortable operating in a high-growth, fast-paced environment with shifting priorities.

jobs.title: Senior Software Engineer, Windows/Desktop Applications - Brighton, United Kingdom
jobs.description:
Mission

The mission of Speechify is to make sure that reading is never a barrier to learning.

Over 50 million people use Speechify's text-to-speech products to turn whatever they're reading – PDFs, books, Google Docs, news articles, websites – into audio, so they can read faster, read more, and remember more. Speechify's text-to-speech reading products include its iOS app, Android App, Mac App, Chrome Extension, and Web App. Google recently named Speechify the Chrome Extension of the Year and Apple named Speechify its 2025 Design Award winner for Inclusivity.  

Today, nearly 200 people around the globe work on Speechify in a 100% distributed setting – Speechify has no office. These include frontend and backend engineers, AI research scientists, and others from Amazon, Microsoft, and Google, leading PhD programs like Stanford, high growth startups like Stripe, Vercel, Bolt, and many founders of their own companies

What You'll Do
  • Lead the design, architecture, and development of native Windows desktop applications using Windows App SDK, WinUI (or related UI frameworks), C#, XAML, and — when needed — C++.
  • Define and enforce best-practices for Windows desktop development across the codebase: code architecture, performance, memory usage, responsive UI, cross-version compatibility (Windows 10/11+), and maintainability.
  • Drive accessibility efforts: integrate and validate support for accessibility APIs (e.g. Microsoft UI Automation or other relevant Windows accessibility frameworks), ensure UI controls, focus management, keyboard navigation, screen-reader support, and usability for users with disabilities.
  • Collaborate closely with product designers, UX researchers, QA, and other stakeholders to shape feature planning, UI/UX architecture, and long-term roadmap for the Windows platform.
  • Take ownership of full lifecycle of features: conception → design → implementation → testing → release → maintenance. Ensure quality, reliability, and consistency across releases.
  • Identify, diagnose, and resolve complex bugs, performance bottlenecks, memory leaks, rendering issues, or compatibility problems — and propose robust architectural or design solutions.
 
An ideal candidate should have

Required:

  • 3+ in Windows desktop application development using Windows App SDK, WinUI (or similar), C#, XAML — and ideally additional experience with native Windows code (C++, Win32/WinRT/COM).
  • Deep understanding of Windows application architecture, including interop between managed code (.NET) and native code.
  • Proven track record of designing, building, and shipping production-quality desktop applications, with an emphasis on reliability, performance, scalability, and maintainability.
  • Strong experience with accessibility APIs on Windows (e.g. Microsoft UI Automation or similar), and a dedication to building accessible and inclusive software.
  • Excellent software engineering fundamentals: OOP, design patterns, data structures, algorithms, memory management, multi-threading or asynchronous programming (where relevant).
  • Experience leading technical design, mentoring other engineers, conducting code reviews, and making architecture-level decisions.
  • Strong communication skills; ability to articulate tradeoffs, collaborate with cross-functional teams, and drive consensus.
  • A user-centric mindset: focus on building polished, intuitive, and accessible experiences for end users.

Preferred / Bonus:

  • Experience with writing automated tests for UI — unit tests, integration tests, UI automation tests; familiarity with relevant testing frameworks.
  • Experience with performance optimization for desktop apps (memory usage, startup time, rendering performance, high-DPI support, responsiveness under load).
  • Experience with localization/globalization, right-to-left UI support, internationalization, accessibility for multiple regions.
  • Familiarity with telemetry, analytics, crash reporting, logging, and error monitoring in desktop applications.
  • Previous experience in shaping CI/CD workflows, release pipelines, and deployment strategies for desktop applications.
  • Demonstrated ability to take ownership of feature areas or modules and drive them long-term, including maintenance, refactoring, and technical debt management.

What we offer

  • A high-impact role: you will define architecture, shape the future of our Windows product, and directly influence what millions of users see and experience.
  • A collaborative, flat-structure engineering culture — you are not just a coder, but a builder and a decision-maker.
  • Opportunities to lead — mentor others, steer technical direction, and grow into broader technical leadership (e.g. Tech Lead, Architect).
  • Flexibility, autonomy, and responsibility: you define how to solve problems, own features end-to-end, and contribute to long-term product vision.
  • A purpose-driven mission: building software that's reliable, accessible, and user-centered — making a real difference for people.

And don't forget to include links to your portfolio and LinkedIn.

Refer them!

jobs.title: Senior Embedded Software Engineer – EO/IR Gimbal Systems (m/f/d)
jobs.description:
We are seeking a highly skilled Senior Embedded Software Engineer to lead the development of software for next-generation defense-grade Electro-Optical/Infrared (EO/IR) gimbal systems. The successful candidate will architect and develop high-performance, low-latency video processing and streaming software for embedded computing platforms while integrating cameras, sensors, communication interfaces, and embedded hardware into a mission-critical stabilization and targeting system.

This role requires strong expertise in embedded Linux, multimedia frameworks, GPU-accelerated computing, networking, and hardware/software integration. You will collaborate closely with systems, electronics, computer vision, mechanical, and control engineers to deliver robust, production-ready solutions for demanding defense applications.



What is your Day to Day Mission:

  • Design, develop, and maintain embedded software for defense-grade EO/IR gimbal systems.

  • Develop real-time video capture, processing, encoding, decoding, recording, and streaming applications on embedded Linux platforms using GStreamer, FFmpeg, and hardware-accelerated multimedia frameworks.

  • Develop reliable networking solutions for real-time video transport using RTP, RTSP, UDP, TCP, H.264, and H.265.

  • Develop high-performance image processing and computer vision applications using CUDA, OpenCV, or equivalent GPU-accelerated technologies where applicable.

  • Integrate visible, infrared, and thermal imaging sensors into embedded systems.

  • Develop software interfaces for IMUs, laser rangefinders, and other mission-critical sensors.

  • Develop Linux device drivers and perform kernel-level integration for custom hardware.

  • Interface with embedded hardware using SPI, I²C, UART, CAN, GPIO, USB, Ethernet, MIPI CSI, HDMI, and other industry-standard interfaces.

  • Optimize software for deterministic performance, low latency, and efficient utilization of CPU, GPU, and hardware accelerators.

  • Design scalable communication architectures between embedded processors, payload controllers, flight controllers, and external systems.

  • Support hardware bring-up, integration, debugging, verification, and field testing.

  • Implement logging features and analyze issues reported by testing and customers

  • Produce software architecture documentation, interface specifications, and technical documentation.

  • Participate in system architecture, design reviews, and technology roadmap planning.



What you bring to the team:

  • Bachelor's or Master's degree in Computer Engineering, Computer Science, Electrical Engineering, Embedded Systems, Robotics, or a related discipline.

  • 5+ years of professional experience developing embedded software for Linux-based systems.

  • Strong expertise in Embedded Linux application development.

  • Experience with Linux kernel development, device drivers, and hardware abstraction layers.

  • Strong C/C++ and/or Rust programming skills.

  • Experience with GStreamer and/or FFmpeg multimedia frameworks for low-latency, high-performance multimedia and video streaming applications.

  • Experience with H.264/H.265 video codecs and streaming technologies including RTSP, RTP, UDP, and TCP.

  • Experience integrating embedded peripherals using SPI, UART, I²C, CAN, GPIO, USB, Ethernet, and similar interfaces.

  • Experience integrating imaging sensors and peripherals such as IMUs, GPS, encoders, or similar devices.

  • Strong understanding of networking fundamentals and troubleshooting in embedded or distributed systems.

  • Experience with hardware/software integration and embedded system debugging.

  • Familiarity with GPU computing, OpenCV, CUDA, or equivalent hardware acceleration technologies.

  • Experience with Git, CMake, cross-compilation, and embedded Linux development workflows.

  • Strong systems thinking with an understanding of software architecture and hardware/software interface design.


Why Quantum-Systems:

  • We believe in the power of combined efforts: straightforward tech expertise paired with a customer-centric focus.

  • We are industry pioneers who are ambitious, bold, and visionary.

  • We push limits, think outside-the-box and strive for technological excellence to shape the future of aerial data.

  • We promise to be your runway for individual and professional growth.


Our benefits:

  • Company pension scheme: We support you so that you can already make provisions for later.

  • Flexible working hours: With trust-based working hours, you are not only responsible for your working hours, but also for your work-life balance.

  • Mobile Work: If things get a little busy in the office, you have the option to work remotely one flexible day per week to create the right balance.

  • Stay active: With EGYM Wellpass, you get access to thousands of fitness and sports facilities — and of course, we subsidize the membership.

  • Bike-Leasing: We support you in staying environmentally mobile and healthy.

  • Corporate Benefits: Your opportunity for attractive offers and discounts from well-known suppliers and brands, e.g. Adidas, Apple, Expedia.

  • Employee events: We not only want to grow together, but also celebrate our successes together.

  • Lunch-Card: Be powerful with delicious energy, daily lunch budget is sponsored.

  • Company Shuttle: Enjoy our convenient shuttle service that picks you up from Laim in Munich and brings you to our location, with return trips at the end of the workday.


About us:

Quantum Systems specialises in the development, design, and production of small Unmanned Aerial Systems (sUAS). The company’s range of electric vertical take-off and landing (eVTOL) sUAS are built to maximize range and versatility and to provide operators with a seamless user experience. By integrating cutting-edge software capabilities, like edge computing and real-time AI-powered data processing, Quantum Systems is building next-generation UAS for clients in defence, security, public sectors.

At our company, every voice is heard and every perspective is valued. We believe that our differences enrich us and help us to find creative solutions and generate innovative ideas. We pride ourselves on creating an inclusive work environment where all employees can reach their full potential.

jobs.title: AI Engineer (m/f/d)
jobs.description:
We’re looking for an engineer who builds AI systems that create real impact in production (not just demos) and has worked with retrieval or agent-based approaches on enterprise data.

At Natuvion, we move business-critical data and processes between platforms. This data enables powerful AI — but also comes with complexity, sensitivity, and high stakes. We use AI to automate internal processes and to build intelligent features into our products, and you’ll work across both areas.

We operate with strictly protected data that is never exposed to external LLMs, supported by a strong authorization model. Self-hosted models are an important part of our strategy.

Our core stack is built in Go with gRPC-based services, including a custom AI router. While AI work may start in Python, production services are built in Go — and you’ll own them end-to-end.

We deliberately stay flexible with our AI stack. The field evolves quickly, and we value engineers who stay current, think critically, and bring ideas to the table.

This role focuses on building robust, production-grade systems designed to be operated, evaluated, and improved over time. We’re looking for someone who prioritizes maintainability, thoughtful evaluation, and chooses the right tool for the job.

If that excites you, we’d love to hear from you.

Your Responsibilities:

  • Design, build, and operate RAG solutions across the full spectrum — from semantic search through to retrieval over highly structured data and knowledge graphs 

  • Build agentic systems that perform multi-step tasks reliably and safely against enterprise data 

  • Drive automation of internal processes with AI, and ship AI features into customer-facing products 

  • Own retrieval quality end to end: chunking and embedding strategies, hybrid and re-ranking approaches, and the evaluation that proves it works 

  • Evaluate and recommend the tooling for our AI stack — vector stores, orchestration, retrieval frameworks, model choices — and drive those decisions together with our architect. We expect informed proposals, not a wait for instructions 

  • Author production services in Go (gRPC) and integrate them with our AI router and existing platform; prototype and iterate in Python 

  • Make grounded technical decisions — retrieval vs. fine-tuning vs. prompting vs. a classical approach — and defend the trade-offs in architectural reviews 


  • You hold a degree in Business Informatics or Computer Science

  • You have several years of experience, a strong Python proficiency for AI development, and genuine comfort working in Go — you're 100% willing and able to author production gRPC services, not just call them 

  • A proven track record of building AI features on enterprise data that actually shipped and stayed in production 

  • Real understanding of the fundamentals behind modern RAG: embeddings and vector similarity, retrieval and ranking, and how transformer-based models behave. You reason about why a pipeline succeeds or fails — you don't guess 

  • Hands-on experience designing and evaluating retrieval and agentic systems, including building your own metrics and eval rather than trusting vibes 

  • Experience with knowledge graphs or structured/semantic data representations is a strong plus 

  • Curiosity that shows: ideally you've fine-tuned a small model yourself (LoRA / QLoRA or similar) and understand the basics of what's happening under the hood 

  • You stay genuinely current in a fast-moving field and hold reasoned opinions. You can walk into a discussion with our architect with a concrete recommendation and defend the trade-offs — and change your mind when the evidence says so 

  • Comfortable in cloud-native environments — you think about observability, failure modes, and cost as first-class concerns 

  • Professional working proficiency in English — you can explain complex technical ideas clearly to peers and stakeholders 

If you think that you don't meet all the requirements: With us, there are "no limits" to your development! Go your way with us - we support you! Just show us who you are.

What you can expect from us:

An environment that is always open to change and optimization. There is no "it's always been like this" with us. You have the opportunity to contribute your knowledge, design processes, standardize existing topics or optimize workflows. Be a source of inspiration and bring us even further forward with your expertise!

We create conditions in which you feel comfortable:

  • Home office contracts & absolute flexibility through free organization of working hours

  • Permanent position and 30 days of vacation

  • FlexWork: Work remotely from other European countries for up to 3 months per year

  • Monthly budget for individually selectable benefits from over 50 possible offers via emplu, various offers via corporate benefits, as well as bicycle and car leasing via salary conversion

  • Mental Health Benefit 'Nilo' – 10 free sessions with psychologists annually as well as access to meditations and courses

  • We provide you with targeted support in your professional and personal development at Natuvion

  • Mentoring program for a structured and personal induction

  • Be part of the #teamgreen - At Natuvion, you'll work on innovative projects as part of a team that stands up for each other. We rely on cooperation, openness and trust

  • Modern equipment and central offices in Walldorf, Berlin, Munich and Leipzig

  • Your long-term perspective is important to us, which is why we subsidize your company pension scheme as well as capital-forming benefits

Join #teamgreen - Natuvion is a digital moving company.

Our team does not move tables, filing cabinets or chairs. Natuvion transports business-critical data and processes from one technology platform to another. Typical Natuvion "relocation services" include data migration, data transformation, data integration, data privacy, data security, and data quality.

Our >400 consultants and developers in Germany, Austria, Slovakia, the USA and Australia have extensive know-how in (SAP)® projects and a profound understanding of processes across industry boundaries. In this way, we enable companies to always use their data and processes on the most modern and innovative platforms.

We're looking for a Forward Deployed Engineer to sit between our platform and the people who use it, quickly turning what our team and our clients actually need into working software.

Who we are 👪

We believe live music is one of the best things humans do, and that far more artists deserve to make a living from it than currently can. That's the opportunity we're building for.

The industry still runs on cold emails and who-knows-who, and it's about to be rebuilt. AI now lets small teams achieve incredible things, and we intend to be the team that rebuilds this one.

Otherworldly is an AI-native talent management and booking company. We run an actual roster, meaning real tours, real riders, real settlements, and we're turning everything we've learned into agentic infrastructure. That means a database of 250,000+ bookers worldwide and algorithmic pitching systems that get the right artist in front of the right promoter at scale.

It's working. We closed our seed round with roster and revenue traction already built. Between us, we've managed No.1 artists and Grammy nominees, led strategy for household-name brands, and founded YC-backed companies. Most music-tech is built by people who've never booked a show, but we book shows every week.

Tasks

Most companies keep their engineers away from customers.

We do the opposite.

Our team runs real tours, pitches real promoters, and manages real artists every day, and every one of those workflows is a system waiting to be built. Your job is to live at that boundary. That means watching the work happen, finding the friction, and shipping the feature that removes it.

● Embed with the booking and artist-care teams. Sit with them, watch how they actually work, and turn the messiest, most manual parts of their day into software

● Build and ship end-to-end. You'll take a problem from "the team keeps doing this by hand" to a deployed, working feature, often in days, not sprints

● Own the last mile of the agentic platform. The integrations, workflows, and interfaces that decide whether our AI systems actually provide value

● Close the loop between roster and product. You're the person who hears an artist's or booker's real problem and comes back with a solution, then feeds what you learn back into the core platform

● Be the technical face to our users when it counts. You're comfortable in the room with a manager, a promoter, or an artist, not just behind a screen

Requirements

You'll thrive here if...

🚢 You ship fast and talk to users. You're comfortable reading a spec or sitting with the person who has the problem. You prototype, iterate, and get something working fast.

🛠 You're a generalist who finishes things. Frontend, backend, glue code, an LLM call, a scrappy integration, you'll do whatever the problem needs, and you take it all the way to deployed and used

📈 You hold yourself to a high bar. You've shown ambition and excellence somewhere in your life - professionally, academically, or otherwise, and you want your work to matter

🎵 You love music, or want to work for people who do. Everything we build exists to get artists booked, paid, and heard.

Our must-have Requirements 🤝

● Strong full-stack engineering experience. You can build and ship a working product feature end-to-end, from data to interface, without waiting on anyone

● Comfort integrating LLMs into real products. You feel comfortable with API calls, prompt design, structured outputs, and knowing when the model is the wrong tool

● A track record of shipping fast in ambiguous, early-stage environments. Be that startups, founding teams, or your own projects

● Excellent communication and a genuine willingness to spend time with non-technical users, understand their work, and earn their trust

● Solid Python and/or JavaScript/TypeScript, and the pragmatism to pick up whatever the job needs

Strong plus ✅

● Experience as a forward deployed / solutions / founding engineer, or any role where you owned the boundary between product and customer

● Familiarity with agentic frameworks and the LLM stack (embeddings, vector DBs, RAG, evaluation)

● Background building internal tools, workflow automation, or CRM/outbound systems ● A real connection to the music industry or its tools

Benefits

What we offer 🎁

● Direct influence on the product roadmap from day one

jobs.title: Senior Consultant, Advisory and Risk Consulting (Manager m/w/d)
jobs.description:
We are now seeking a highly motivated, detail-oriented and business-minded professional with creativity, initiative, teamwork and project management skills to help drive our advisory and risk consulting practice. Our consultants are focused on helping organizations understand, mitigate, respond to and recover from evolving security threats and risks. Example areas of focus include corporate security, crisis management, business continuity, enterprise risk management, supply chain risk management, emergency response, and insider risk. The role of Senior Consultant is that of a fee-earning consultant who will be expected to market, sell and deliver end-to-end engagements. Ideally you will be based in Berlin but we will consider applicants based in Frankfurt am Main.

Tasks and Responsibilities

  • To form a strong partnership with the advisory and risk consulting management team to drive long-term, sustainable growth across all risk practice areas in EMEA. 
  • Partner with clients to understand their strategic objectives and design tailored solutions that strengthen resilience, improve decision-making and address evolving risk challenges
  • Lead multiple engagements concurrently, working across EMEA and global teams to bring together the expertise, capabilities and resources required to achieve successful client outcomes
  • Drive the development of innovative consulting products and services, including AI-enabled risk and resilience solutions, that address client needs and maintain Control Risks at the forefront of the sector

Project management

  • Own the commercial performance of engagements, ensuring delivery against financial targets, quality standards, timeline and client expectations.
  • Provide robust forecasting, financial oversight and portfolio management in collaboration with Finance and ARC leadership.
  • Drive efficient resource planning and workforce deployment across regional and global teams to maximize utilization and support business growth

Business development

  • Lead the pursuit and conversion of strategic opportunities, taking overall responsibility for the development of compelling, differentiated and commercially viable client proposals
  • Build and maintain strong client relationships, identifying client needs and contributing to the expansion of existing and future engagements and accounts
  • Work closely with colleagues across the business to develop integrated solutions that address client challenges and create new opportunities for growth
  • Contribute market insight, sector knowledge and thought leadership to strengthen Control Risks' market position and support business development activities
  • Identify emerging client priorities and market trends, including AI and technology-driven developments, and help translate these into innovative client solutions

Requirements

  • Experience delivering consulting engagements across crisis management, emergency management, enterprise risk management (ERM), business continuity management (BCM), security management and organisational resilience in complex or high-risk environments
  • Background in supporting risk, resilience, security and transformation initiatives, including the design and enhancement of frameworks, operating models and capabilities
  • Proven ability to manage consulting engagements and collaborate with multidisciplinary teams to achieve strategic and operational objectives
  • Commercially aware, with experience in project planning, budgeting, resourcing and client relationship management

Essential

  • Master's degree or advanced diploma in risk management, security studies, geopolitics, international relations, political science or a related discipline
  • A proven track record in consulting is mandatory; prior experience in corporate risk, resilience, security or transformation function is considered advantageous
  • Strong project and stakeholder management capabilities, with experience leading complex engagements and multidisciplinary teams
  • Commercial minded, with basic experience in project planning, budgeting, resource management and client engagement
  • Strong project and stakeholder management skills within a consulting environment
  • People skills, including the ability to inspire and drive the performance of a team of security professionals
  • Strong communication and presentation skills, with the ability to engage and influence senior stakeholders
  • Full professional proficiency in German and English

Benefits

  • Control Risks offers a competitively positioned compensation and benefits package that is transparent and summarised in the full job offer.
  • We operate a discretionary global bonus scheme that incentivises, and rewards individuals based on company and individual performance.
  • Control Risks supports hybrid working arrangements, wherever possible, that emphasise the value of in-person time together - in the office and with our clients - while continuing to support flexible and remote working.

jobs.title: Senior Data Analyst (f/m/x)
Personalsachbearbeiter / HR Administration (m/w/d)
jobs.description:
Über die Bovensiepen Gruppe

Was Burkard Bovensiepen 1965 in Kaufbeuren begründete, ist heute ein international anerkanntes Familienunternehmen mit eigener Handschrift: Die Bovensiepen Gruppe – geführt von seinen Söhnen Andreas und Florian Bovensiepen – steht für automobilen Anspruch, handwerkliche Exzellenz und die Überzeugung, dass jedes Detail zählt. „Born and made in Buchloe“ ist kein Slogan, sondern ein Versprechen: Was hier entsteht, entsteht mit Hingabe, Präzision und dem unbedingten Willen zur Qualität.

Mit der Übergabe der ALPINA-Markenrechte an BMW zum 31. Dezember 2025 stehen wir mitten in einer der spannendsten Phasen unserer Unternehmensgeschichte: sechs spezialisierte Sparten, eine eigenständige Marke, rund 200 Mitarbeitende. Die organisatorischen Grundlagen sind gelegt. Jetzt beginnt die eigentliche Aufgabe: eine neue Organisation zum Leben bringen, eine veränderte Führungskultur verankern und die richtigen Menschen für die nächste Phase gewinnen und entwickeln.Dafür suchen wir eine Personalsachbearbeitung, die sorgfältige Sachbearbeitung mit Mitdenken verbindet – und die in einer wachsenden Organisation den nächsten Schritt vorbereiten will.

Aufgaben

Ihre Rolle – drei Säulen der operativen Personalarbeit

Sie arbeiten in drei Säulen der operativen Personalarbeit zu und mit: in der Zeitwirtschaft (Pflege und Administration des Systems, Fehlzeiten, Schnittstellenprüfung zur extern vergebenen Entgeltabrechnung), im Recruiting (Ausschreibungen schalten, Bewerbermanagement, Telefonscreenings koordinieren, Kandidatenkommunikation) und in der operativen Personalarbeit von Verträgen über Zeugnisse bis zum Onboarding. Sie berichten an Janet Weiss (Leitung Personal), stimmen sich eng mit ihr ab und haben dabei Gestaltungsspielraum in Absprache – Entscheidungen und Verantwortung liegen bei der Personalleitung.

Zur Einordnung, damit die Erwartungen von Anfang an stimmen: Dies ist bewusst eine Sachbearbeitungsstelle, noch keine Referentenrolle. Nach der Übergabe der ALPINA-Markenrechte an BMW stellt sich unsere Organisation neu auf – sechs Sparten, wachsende Mannschaft, Prozesse, die mitwachsen müssen. Saubere, verlässliche Personaladministration ist dabei kein Hintergrundrauschen, sondern das Fundament, auf dem alles andere aufsetzt. Noch etwas zur Präsenz: 200 Mitarbeitende brauchen ein Personalteam, das da ist, wenn man es braucht – deshalb arbeiten Sie gerade in der Anfangszeit vor Ort in Buchloe. Nach der Einarbeitung ist Homeoffice perspektivisch nach Absprache möglich. Unsere Arbeitszeit läuft von Montag bis Freitagmittag.

Ihre Aufgaben

  • Pflege und Administration der Zeitwirtschaft im Tagesgeschäft
  • Schnittstellenprüfung zur extern vergebenen Entgeltabrechnung: Sie liefern die Daten termingerecht und prüfen die Ergebnisse, bevor sie rausgehen
  • Recruiting im Tagesgeschäft: Stellenausschreibungen schalten, Bewerbermanagement führen, Telefonscreenings koordinieren
  • Kandidatenkommunikation mit Tempo und Verbindlichkeit – jede Bewerbung bekommt eine schnelle, persönliche Antwort
  • Operative Personalarbeit von A bis Z: Arbeitsverträge, Zeugnisse, Bescheinigungswesen, Personalakten
  • Organisation des Onboardings neuer Kolleginnen und Kollegen – vom Vertragsversand bis zum ersten Arbeitstag
  • Vertretung der Teamkolleginnen und -kollegen im Personalteam sowie Mitarbeit an der Weiterentwicklung der HR-Prozesse.

Sachbearbeitung heißt bei uns nicht Abarbeiten nach Schema: Sie denken mit, schlagen vor und gestalten in Absprache mit der Personalleitung – und prägen so mit, wie verlässlich sich Personalarbeit für 200 Menschen anfühlt.

Qualifikation

Ihr Profil – genau, schnell, verbindlich

Sie arbeiten gern genau, zügig und verlässlich – und wollen dabei mitdenken statt nur abarbeiten. Sie schätzen klare Abstimmung mit Ihrer Führungskraft, übernehmen Aufgaben aber selbstständig, sobald der Rahmen steht. Und Sie springen ein, wenn Kolleginnen oder Kollegen ausfallen – Vertretung gehört für Sie selbstverständlich dazu.

Was Sie mitbringen

  • Abgeschlossene kaufmännische Ausbildung, idealerweise mit Weiterbildung zum Personalfachkaufmann (m/w/d) oder vergleichbar
  • 3–5 Jahre Berufserfahrung in der operativen Personalarbeit, idealerweise in Industrie oder Mittelstand
  • Praxis in Zeitwirtschaft und in der Vorbereitung oder Prüfung von Entgeltabrechnungen
  • Erfahrung im Recruiting-Tagesgeschäft: Ausschreibungen, Bewerbermanagement, Kandidatenkontakt
  • Absolute Diskretion und Sorgfalt im Umgang mit Personaldaten sowie solide Grundlagen im Arbeits- und Sozialversicherungsrecht
  • Sicherer Umgang mit HR-Software und MS Office, insbesondere Excel.

Das Spektrum ist breit, das Tempo hoch, und es gibt keine Großkonzern-Personalabteilung im Rücken – Prozesse und Routinen entstehen zum Teil erst mit Ihnen. Wer eine eng zugeschnittene Spezialistenrolle mit fertigen Abläufen sucht, wird hier nicht glücklich. Wer gestalten will, schon.

Benefits

Was wir bieten

Familienunternehmen seit mehr als 60 Jahren: Flache Hierarchien, kurze Entscheidungswege, keine Konzernlogik. Ihre Ideen landen direkt dort, wo Entscheidungen getroffen werden.

  • Breites Aufgabenfeld ab Tag eins: Zeitwirtschaft, Recruiting und operative Personalarbeit – Sie sehen das ganze Spektrum statt eines schmalen Ausschnitts
  • Echtes Wochenende ab Freitagmittag: Arbeitszeit Montag bis Freitagmittag – der Freitagnachmittag gehört Ihnen
  • Attraktives Vergütungspaket: verlässliches Fixgehalt, vermögenswirksame Leistungen, JobRad und freier Parkplatz direkt am Standort
  • Langfristige Perspektive: Wer sich in der Sachbearbeitung beweist, wächst mit der Organisation – perspektivisch Richtung HR-Generalist oder Referentenrolle
  • Standort Buchloe im Allgäu: Hohe Lebensqualität, direkte Anbindung Richtung München, Memmingen und Augsburg.

Bereit?

Wenn Sie beim Lesen gedacht haben: genau diese Mischung aus Sorgfalt, Mitdenken und Perspektive suche ich – dann bewerben Sie sich! Wir freuen uns auf Ihre Unterlagen unter Angabe Ihrer Gehaltsvorstellung und Ihres frühestmöglichen Eintrittstermins. Bei Fragen können Sie sich gerne an Janet Weiss (Leitung Personal) wenden: +49 8241 5005-439.

Location: Hybrid, Munich

Team & Reporting line:  Satellite Systems team, reporting to the Satellite Systems Lead

Our Mission 

At constellr, we're harnessing the power of space to solve one of Earth’s greatest challenges: climate resilience & security in a changing world. Our thermal satellite constellation delivers the most accurate land surface temperature data on the market, equipping commercial players, governments, defence agencies, and global institutions with the thermal intelligence they need to make strategic decisions– from national security and infrastructure to agriculture and climate resilience. 
 
As a fast-scaling company with offices in Brussels, Freiburg, Munich, Washington and Toulouse, our multidisciplinary team of engineers, scientists, and strategists is building the future of space-based Earth observation.

Your Role:

We are looking for an experienced AIT Technician to lead and execute integration activities for optical payloads. The successful candidate will initially support the integration of an existing payload and will then independently perform AIT activities on future units, contributing to planning, optimisation, and troubleshooting.

This role requires the ability to operate effectively in a fast-paced and evolving environment, adapting quickly to changes in planning, technical constraints, and project needs. A high level of autonomy and ownership is expected, with the capability to work independently while coordinating closely with engineering teams and external partners.

Key Responsibilities:

  • Coordinate and maintain constellr’s AIT facility, supporting initial set-up, procurement activities, and the maintenance and calibration of AIT equipment.

  • Perform mechanical and electrical integration of optical payloads with a high level of autonomy, including the assembly of complex subassemblies and instruments, interpreting drawings, procedures, and interface requirements.

  • Support or perform optical integration activities, including optical subsystem alignment (depending on experience) and the handling of precision optical equipment.

  • Support optical testing activities and prepare test setups for radiometric and geometric characterisation.

  • Execute and oversee instrumentation integration, including the installation and routing of accelerometers, thermocouples, thermistors, and heaters, verifying proper installation and signal integrity.

  • Perform advanced electrical integration tasks, including harness assembly (crimping, splicing, connector mating) and verification using electrical measurements (resistance, continuity, insulation checks).

  • Perform and supervise bonding activities using space-qualified adhesives (e.g., structural, conductive) and verify bonding quality and process compliance.

  • Contribute to AIT planning and execution by reviewing and improving procedures, estimating task durations, and identifying risks.

  • Lead test preparation and execution support, including the installation of instrumentation for environmental tests and troubleshooting during test campaigns.

  • Ensure documentation and traceability, including as-run procedures, non-conformance reporting, and configuration tracking.

  • Interface across multiple engineering teams and external suppliers, and mentor junior technicians.


About you 

Required: 

  • Technical education (vocational training or diploma) in mechatronics, aerospace, mechanical, or electronic systems.

  • Several years of experience in AIT, manufacturing, or integration of complex systems (preferably in space, aerospace, or optical instrumentation).

  • Strong experience in mechanical assembly of precision hardware, including optical alignments, usage of adhesives, and electrical integration (splicing, crimping, soldering, verification).

  • Proven ability to read and interpret mechanical, electrical, and integration documentation, working independently with minimal supervision.

  • Solid knowledge of cleanroom operations, ESD handling, and relevant quality standards.

  • Experience with basic electrical measurements and troubleshooting, alongside a strong problem-solving mindset and sharp attention to detail.

  • Good communication skills with the ability to work effectively in international teams.

  • Fluency in English (German language skills are considered an asset).

Nice to Have: 

  • Experience with optical payloads, opto-mechanical systems, or optical alignment techniques.

  • Experience with metrology and alignment equipment (e.g., hexapods, theodolites, laser trackers, CMM, interferometers, collimators, black bodies).

  • Certification or experience in IPC standards for wiring and soldering (e.g., IPC/WHMA-A-620, J-STD-001) or adhesive application (EWF/EAB or equivalent).

  • Experience in environmental test campaigns (vibration, thermal vacuum) for space hardware.

Why join constellr?

  • High-Impact National Security Mission: Be part of an ambitious mission to launch the world’s first commercial thermal infrared constellation, delivering sovereign-grade "behavioural" intelligence from space to close critical blind spots for defence, intelligence, and maritime surveillance agencies.

  • Fast-Paced "New Space" Innovation: Work at the leading edge of a rapidly evolving defence sector. By leveraging modern, agile New Space methodologies, you will help design, build, and deploy dual-use thermal payloads into operational orbit at a speed and scale that traditional aerospace models simply cannot match.

  • Broad Interdisciplinary Exposure: Accelerate your professional growth by collaborating daily with a diverse, international cohort of astrophysicists, software developers, and defence-system engineers.

  • Inclusive & Scientific Culture: Join a high-trust team deeply committed to diversity, inclusion, and scientific excellence, where academic curiosity is paired with high autonomy and a flat hierarchy.

  • Financial Upside & Well-being: Benefit from a Virtual Share Option Plan (VSOP) for permanent employees, giving you a true stake in the company's growth, alongside highly flexible hybrid working models.

jobs.title: Content Specialist
jobs.description:
Working Student (20h/week), Full-time or Freelance

**
Native German 🇩🇪 AND Fluent English 🇺🇸**

We believe talent is everywhere. The chance to live from it isn't.

Millions of creators are talented and invisible at the same time. The value they create flows to middlemen, while the brands who want to reach them are stuck in a non-transparent, fragmented market. So we built the tools to fix both sides at once. Creators turn an account into an income: join a campaign in minutes, make something they're proud of, and get paid fairly for creativity, not follower count. Brands brief once, activate hundreds of creators, and see content live within 24 hours.

Next year, 10,000 creators will make a living from WePush. When a creator earns, a brand grows. When a brand grows, more creators earn. WePush is the fastest-growing creator marketing platform in Europe, with over 150,000 creators and 500,000+ collaborations powering brands like L'Oréal, ABOUT YOU, Zalando, and Sony Music. Two numbers matter to us: how many people make a living through WePush, and how many millions of people brands reach through them.

Aufgaben

What you'll do:

  • The bulk of your time: Be on camera and build formats that make WePush and SongPush visible on TikTok and Instagram 🎥
  • Identify, develop, and produce content formats independently, from first idea to published post
  • Translate less obvious material such as internal processes, performance data, and behind-the-scenes work into content people love
  • Own TikTok and Instagram end to end: posting, community, and staying ahead of trends
  • Work closely with the team to turn campaigns, creator stories, and company milestones into content
  • Test formats continuously and adapt quickly based on performance

Qualifikation

What you bring

  • Exceptionally communicative: you're comfortable talking to a camera, an audience or a room
  • Energetic with an edge. You have a voice and know when to use it
  • A steady stream of ideas, more than there is time to produce
  • A strong instinct for content and genuine enjoyment of being on camera
  • The ability to spot, develop, and execute formats on your own, without a step-by-step brief
  • Strong identification with TikTok, social media, and WePush as a brand
  • Hands-on experience producing for TikTok and Instagram

Benefits

Why work at WePush

This is a rare chance to shape a brand from the front rather than produce content for an established one. WePush is backed by operators who built the creator and music industry from the inside, including former leaders from Spotify and Google, and we're currently raising our Series A to fuel the next phase of growth. You'll work directly with the founders, and your content goes live instead of disappearing into approval loops.

Why you might not want this

This role isn't for someone waiting on a finished content calendar. We're still early-stage, not a polished scale-up, so processes are half-built, things change weekly, and you'll often figure out what works yourself instead of following a playbook. If being on camera and visible drains you, or you need clear instructions to get moving, you'll be miserable here. But if you read all that and got more interested, not less, we should talk.

What we offer

  • Flexible entry: working student at 20h/week, full-time, or freelance on a trial basis
  • Direct access to founders and leadership
  • A spot in our office with a fast-moving, in-person team
  • Real creative ownership. Your ideas, your execution
  • The chance to become the face and the voice of a fast-growing brand
  • Urban Sports Club membership and other benefits of your choice
  • Flexible working hours and remote work when needed
  • International creator, music, media and startup network

Regardless of who you are, where you come from, how you look, or what music is playing in your headphones, you are welcome. We encourage applications from individuals of all gender identities, sexual orientations, personal expressions, ethnicities, religious beliefs, and disability statuses.

jobs.title: Senior Data Engineer (m/w/d)
jobs.description:
Du möchtest nicht nur Daten verarbeiten, sondern eine moderne Datenplattform entwickeln, die Analysen, Reporting und datengetriebene Entscheidungen im gesamten Unternehmen ermöglicht? 

Dann könnte diese Position genau das Richtige für dich sein. 

Unser Kunde, ein dynamisch wachsende E-Commerce Service Agentur in Berlin, zählt zu den erfolgreichsten Amazon-Händlern Deutschlands und vertreibt tausende Produkte 

Für den weiteren Ausbau der Data & Analytics Landschaft wird eine Persönlichkeit gesucht, die moderne Datenarchitekturen entwickelt und den Weg zu einer datengetriebenen Organisation aktiv mitgestaltet 

Deine Benefits

  • Attraktive Vergütung: Ein leistungsgerechtes Fixgehalt, das deiner Erfahrung und Qualifikation entspricht.  

  • Flexibles Arbeiten: Hybrides Arbeitsmodell mit 2 Home-Office Tagen, einer 40-Stunden-Woche, Gleitzeit mit Arbeitsbeginn zwischen 6:00 und 10:00 Uhr.  

  • Langfristige Sicherheit: Unbefristeter Arbeitsvertrag sowie 30 Urlaubstage in einem wirtschaftlich erfolgreichen und zukunftssicheren Unternehmen.  

  • Weiterentwicklung: Ob fachlich oder persönlich – deine Entwicklung wird aktiv gefördert und langfristig begleitet.  

  • Modernes Arbeitsumfeld: Freue dich auf ein modernes Büro im Berliner Bezirk Lichtenberg.  

  • Mobilität: Ob mit den öffentlichen Verkehrsmitteln oder dem Auto – profitiere von einem bezuschussten Jobticket oder kostenlosen Parkplätzen direkt am Büro.  

  • Teamkultur: Flache Hierarchien, offene Kommunikation, eine gelebte Du-Kultur und regelmäßige Team- sowie Firmenevents wie „Grill & Chill“ sorgen für ein starkes Miteinander.  

  • Verpflegung: Kostenlose Getränke sowie frisches Obst stehen dir im Arbeitsalltag jederzeit zur Verfügung.  

  • Mitarbeitervorteile: Profitiere von attraktiven Mitarbeiterrabatten auf das Sortiment sowie weiteren Corporate Benefits. 

Deine Aufgaben

Als Data Engineer entwickelst und betreibst du moderne Datenplattformen in Microsoft Azure und Microsoft Fabric und sorgst dafür, dass hochwertige Daten zuverlässig für Analysen, Reporting und Machine-Learning-Anwendungen bereitstehen. 

  • Data Engineering: Konzeption, Entwicklung und kontinuierliche Weiterentwicklung moderner Datenpipelines in Microsoft Azure und Microsoft Fabric.  

  • Datenqualität: Sicherstellung einer hohen Datenqualität, Vollständigkeit und Reproduzierbarkeit sowie Implementierung effizienter inkrementeller Datenladeprozesse.  

  • Datenintegration: Entwicklung und Pflege effizienter ETL-/ELT-Prozesse sowie API-basierter Datenintegrationen.  

  • Plattformbetrieb: Entwicklung robuster Monitoring-, Logging- und Fehlerbehandlungskonzepte sowie kontinuierliche Optimierung von Performance, Kosten und Datenworkflows.  

  • Data Architecture: Mitarbeit am Aufbau einer skalierbaren Datenarchitektur inklusive Test-, Staging- und Produktionsumgebungen sowie moderner Technologien wie CI/CD, Fabric Pipelines, dbt oder Airflow.  

  • Zusammenarbeit: Enge Abstimmung mit dem Head of Data & Analytics und den Data Analysts zur Bereitstellung hochwertiger Daten für Power BI Dashboards und Machine-Learning-Modelle. 

Dein Profil als Data Engineer

  • Mindestens 3–5 Jahre Berufserfahrung im Aufbau und Betrieb von Datenpipelines oder Datenplattformen – idealerweise auf Senior-Level, motivierte Mid-Level-Profile sind ebenfalls willkommen.  

  • Fundierte Kenntnisse in Microsoft Azure Data Services, insbesondere Data Factory und/oder Azure Synapse; idealerweise ergänzt durch Erfahrung mit Microsoft Fabric.  

  • Sehr gute Kenntnisse in SQL und Python, insbesondere im Bereich ETL-/ELT-Prozesse und Automatisierung.  

  • Erfahrung in der Datenmodellierung, idealerweise mit Bronze-, Silver- und Gold-Layer-Architekturen.  

  • Kenntnisse im Datenqualitätsmanagement sowie in Monitoring, Logging und Performance-Optimierung.  

  • Erfahrung in der eigenverantwortlichen Umsetzung technischer Projekte sowie eine strukturierte, lösungsorientierte Arbeitsweise.  

  • Ausgeprägte Teamorientierung sowie Freude an der Zusammenarbeit in einem internationalen Umfeld.  

  • Fließende Deutsch- oder Englischkenntnisse. Bei geringeren Deutschkenntnissen (ab B1) werden dafür sehr gute Englischkenntnisse vorausgesetzt.  

Nice-to-haves – jedes zusätzliche Know-how ist ein Pluspunkt:

  • Erfahrung mit inkrementellen Ladeprozessen und Delta-Verarbeitung.  

  • Erfahrung in der Datenintegration für Power BI sowie im Umgang mit semantischen Modellen.  

  • Kenntnisse im E-Commerce- oder Amazon-Umfeld.  

  • Erfahrung mit API-basierten Datenintegrationen.  

  • Kenntnisse in CI/CD, z. B. mit GitHub Actions oder Azure DevOps.  

  • Interesse an Machine Learning und dem Aufbau datengetriebener Organisationen.  

  • Erfahrung mit Openbridge.

jobs.title: Senior Consultant (m/w/d) BI & Konsolidierung
jobs.description:
Unser Kunde ist ein spezialisierter Anbieter für Business Intelligence, Unternehmensplanung und Konzernkonsolidierung und begleitet seit vielen Jahren Unternehmen vom Mittelstand bis zum internationalen Konzern bei der Digitalisierung ihrer Finanzprozesse. Im Fokus stehen ganzheitliche Lösungen rund um Reporting, Planung, Forecasting und Konsolidierung auf Basis moderner BI Technologien. 
Gesucht wird ein Senior Consultant, der Finance Verständnis, Beratungskompetenz und analytisches Denken verbindet. In dieser Rolle begleitest du Kunden langfristig bei der Optimierung ihrer Finanz- und Controllingprozesse und entwickelst gemeinsam mit ihnen moderne BI- und Planungslösungen. 

Dich erwartet eine verantwortungsvolle Rolle mit viel Eigenverantwortung, direktem Kundenkontakt und langfristigen Entwicklungsmöglichkeiten in einem spezialisierten Consulting Umfeld. 

Deine Benefits

  • Je nach Qualifikation und Erfahrung erwartet dich ein attraktives Gesamtpaket 

  • Hoher Gestaltungsspielraum: Eigenverantwortliches Arbeiten mit direktem Einfluss auf Kundenprojekte und Unternehmensentwicklung 

  • Flexible Arbeitsgestaltung: Freie Zeiteinteilung orientiert am Kundenbedarf sowie 2-3 Tage Home Office 

  • Remote Möglichkeit: Auch deutschlandweite Remote Zusammenarbeit möglich, abhängig von Wohnort und Reisetätigkeit 

  • Langfristige Entwicklungsperspektive: Möglichkeit zur fachlichen Weiterentwicklung bis hin zur Teamführung oder strategischen Rolle im Unternehmen 

  • Spannende Kundenprojekte: Zusammenarbeit mit namhaften Unternehmen aus unterschiedlichen Branchen im Bereich BI, Planung und Konsolidierung 

  • Mentoring und Wissenstransfer: Enger Austausch im kleinen Team mit direkter Zusammenarbeit mit erfahrenen Spezialisten 

  • Modernes Arbeitsumfeld: Grünes Büro mit Terrasse, Küche und angenehmer Arbeitsatmosphäre 

  • Mobilitätsangebote: Firmenparkplatz, Bike Leasing sowie je nach Rolle Firmenwagen möglich 

  • Starkes Teamgefühl: Kleine Teams, kurze Entscheidungswege und regelmäßige gemeinsame Aktivitäten 

Deine Aufgaben als Senior Consultant

  • Beratung und Betreuung von Kunden im Bereich Business Intelligence, Unternehmensplanung und Konzernkonsolidierung 

  • Analyse fachlicher Anforderungen gemeinsam mit Finance, Controlling und Konzernrechnungswesen 

  • Entwicklung von Konzepten und Lösungsarchitekturen auf Basis von IBM Planning Analytics TM1 

  • Übersetzung betriebswirtschaftlicher Anforderungen in technische Lösungen und Systemkonzepte 

  • Modellierung und Implementierung von OLAP Lösungen, Reports, Dashboards und Planungssystemen 

  • Entwicklung und Optimierung von Datenintegrationen aus ERP, Finanz- und Vorsystemen 

  • Begleitung von Kundenprojekten von der Konzeption bis zur Inbetriebnahme 

  • Durchführung von Workshops, Anwenderschulungen und Präsentationen beim Kunden 

  • Langfristige Betreuung und Weiterentwicklung bestehender Kundenlösungen 

  • Unterstützung bei Presales Aktivitäten, Lösungskonzepten und Kundenpräsentationen

Dein Profil

  • Abgeschlossenes Studium im Bereich BWL, Wirtschaftsinformatik, Finance, Controlling oder vergleichbare Studiengänge 

  • Mindestens 5 Jahre Berufserfahrung im Bereich Business Intelligence, Finanzplanung und Konzernkonsolidierung 

  • Fundierte Kenntnisse in Budgetierung, Forecasting sowie Reporting und Controlling Prozessen 

  • Praxis in der Analyse und Optimierung von Finance- und Controlling Prozessen 

  • Kommunikationsstärke sowie souveränes Auftreten im Austausch mit Kunden und Fachbereichen 

  • Analytische und strukturierte Arbeitsweise mit hoher Eigenverantwortung 

  • Interesse an datengetriebenen Lösungen sowie Verständnis für BI- und Planungssysteme 

  • Fließende Deutschkenntnisse für die optimale Kundenberatung und Kommunikation im Team

  • Gelegentliche Reisebereitschaft für Kundentermine und Workshops (ca. 1x im Monat) 
    Nice to Have:

jobs.title: Senior Flight Control System Engineer
jobs.description:
We are an innovative aerospace startup seeking a Senior Flight Control System Engineer to join our team and who is curious about new technologies such as Autonomous operation and INDI control to develop our cutting-edge drone technology. At Maple Aviation we develop a unique Tail-Sitter Drone, that flies with one propeller only and is controlled in position via a flap-thrust-vectoring system. In this role, you will work closely with our research and development team to develop our Drone Flight Control System and test drone prototypes from concept to final production. You will utilize your skills in Flight Control System modeling, drafting, and coding to create a Flight Control Systems that meets our performance requirements, but also to lead and develop junior Engineers.

Aufgaben

  • Design and programming of flight control algorithms for automatic and autonomous flight
  • Model building for flight dynamic processes and design of control and feedback control laws
  • Preparation and execution of flight tests with UAS systems
  • Analysis of flight data recordings as well as evaluation and processing of test results
  • Generation of code with i.e. Matlab Simulink and its integration into the FCS / autopilot framework
  • Supporting the certification of our product family and obtaining flight permits, e.g. for BVLOS flight projects
  • Collaboration in the further development of the product development process

Qualifikation

  • MA Sc., Dipl., Dr. in mechanical, aerospace, robotics, automotive, electric engineering or related field
  • 4+ years of practical experience in Flight control system modeling and coding
  • Excellent knowledge in the field of flight mechanics, flight dynamic modelling and control engineering. You also have practical experience with model aircraft, evtols, multicopters and / or their subsystems.
  • Excellent knowledge of programming with Matlab/Simulink and Px4 is a must. Fluent handling of the programming language C and Git is also desirable.
  • Interested in model aircraft construction, drones or robotics and can't wait to implement and try out new ideas.
  • You are highly self-motivated and drive your area of responsibility forward independently. You teach us new things that holistically improve our team and make it more efficient.
  • We are an international team communicating in English (other language skills are also an advantage).

Benefits

We offer flexible working hours and a dynamic and innovative work environment in the heart of the TUM startup world in the TUM Venture Labs in Ottobrunn, where you can grow your career in the exciting field of aerospace engineering. jobs.title: Senior Backend Engineer - Activation and Revenue
jobs.description:
In the Global Bank tribe, we're building the infrastructure to provide merchants with a digital business account that empowers them to manage their banking needs. Our goal is to become the most popular banking partner for small merchants globally with an effortless, simple, and affordable experience.

As part of the Bank Activation and Revenue team, you will join a high-impact growth engine within the bank. Our mission is to guide merchants in unlocking the most value out of their SumUp Business Account during their activation journey: we aim to convert 100% of SumUp's ecosystem users into active Bank users.

We own the critical journey from the moment a merchant opens an account until they understand how the business account can solve their business needs, making it part of their daily routine. To achieve this at scale, we are building a greenfield activation and engagement platform consisting of a series of initiatives and experiments to drive adoption and engagement of SumUp users with the business account. Your work will directly drive revenue by enabling seamless cross-selling of the entire SumUp product suite to millions of merchants.

What You'll Do

  • Build Greenfield Services: Design and implement the trifecta of services (Banners, Rewards, and Feature Toggles) from the ground up to power global product experimentation.
  • Drive Activation: Create the technical logic that tracks and incentivizes users through their first five meaningful transactions, ensuring a smooth path to becoming a long-term banking partner.
  • Own the Stack E2E: We follow a "build it, run it, own it" model. You will be responsible for the full lifecycle of your features, from architectural design to production monitoring.
  • High-Velocity Engineering: Participate in a culture of daily deliveries. We value moving fast, testing hypotheses, and iterating based on real-world data.
  • Bridge Client & Backend: Build robust APIs that power the mobile and web banking experience while managing complex asynchronous processing for rewards and incentives via Kafka.
  • Collaborate with Stakeholders: Work closely with other engineering teams across the Bank and the wider SumUp ecosystem to ensure our activation tools are easily integrable and highly scalable.

You'll be great for this role if

  • Strong technical foundation: Solid backend development experience in Golang, with interest in working across multiple languages (Kotlin, Elixir). You understand system architecture, object-oriented and functional design principles, data modeling, and API design (RESTful and event-driven).
  • Growth Mindset: You're curious and energized by complex problem-solving. You thrive in environments with fast iterations and careful design, where understanding the problem deeply is valued over rushing to delivery. You're excited by the opportunity to architect critical systems from scratch - like our new global banner service - and work in a team that follows a "build it, run it" model with daily deliveries.
  • Systems Pragmatist: You understand that supporting and evolving legacy systems is the foundation for future success. You take pride in making existing code better while ensuring new services are architected for the long haul.
  • Ownership and craft: You take full ownership of the software you ship, from design to production readiness. You value clean, maintainable code and continuously refactor to keep designs simple and scalable.
  • Communication: You can communicate complex technical trade-offs effectively to your fellow engineers and technical stakeholders.

What You'll Achieve in 6 Months By your sixth month, you will have taken full ownership of one of our Rewards features and contribute to the Banners service. Banners service will be the primary engine for product discovery and cross-selling within the Bank app, enabling our team to run rapid-fire experiments that directly impact SumUp's bottom line.

Any of the following would be considered a plus

  • Previous experience in a Growth-focused engineering team.
  • Experience building rules engines or Reward/Incentive systems.
  • Familiarity with the Fintech or Banking regulatory landscape.

Why you'll enjoy working at SumUp

  • Be part of a company that values diversity and celebrates unique perspectives.
  • Work with a global team of skilled professionals in an environment that fosters collaboration, learning, and growth.
  • Be part of a global tribe building a banking solution from the ground up and delivering impactful solutions to the real-life problems of millions of SumUp merchants all over the world
  • Career growth and learning opportunities: We invest in your development through regular training, mentorship programs, SumUp University leadership cohort and a yearly learning budget (2,000 EUR)
  • Sabbatical program for tenured SumUppers
  • Join a global team where you belong: Check out our D&I Initiatives and Employee Resource Groups such as Pride Club, SumAfro, Neurodiversity, Grupos Mais, Women in Tech, and more
  • Health & wellness benefits: in-house fitness classes, gym in the office, subsidized Urban Sports Club and available psychotherapy sessions
  • A lot of other benefits such as Subsidized Public Transport Card, Kita placement assistance, Pension Scheme, Language Learning platform/courses etc.
  • Enrollment onto our virtual stock ownership program - you will own a stake in SumUp's future success

About SumUp

At SumUp, we're on a mission to empower small businesses around the world with simple, affordable tools to help them start, run, and grow. More than 4 million merchants across 37 markets trust us as their financial partner — and we're just getting started.

We're a global team of 3,000+ people from over 90 nationalities, united by curiosity, collaboration, and care. Our core valuesOpens in new window and cultureOpens in new window shape everything we do, fostering inclusion, learning, and belonging.

SumUp is proud to be an Equal Employment Opportunity employer, committed to building a safe, respectful, and diverse workplace where everyone can thrive.

👉 Explore more about our culture on our careers site, or follow us on LinkedInOpens in new window and InstagramOpens in new window.

SumUp is proud to be an Equal Employment Opportunity employer, actively seeking and embracing diversity in our workforce. We don't make hiring or employment decisions based on race, colour, religion or religious belief, ethnic or national origin, nationality, sex, gender, gender identity, sexual orientation, disability, age or any other basis protected by applicable laws or prohibited by company policy. Our commitment extends beyond recruitment to creating a safe and respectful workplace where harassment of any form is strictly prohibited.
